title: The Sweet Mango Share
question: How do you encourage your child to share their favorite treats?
caption:
Sharing brings double the joy and sweetness! 🥭✨

scenes.visual: In a vibrant green Indian garden, 6-year-old twin superhero Veer, wearing a blue suit, red cape, blue eye mask, and yellow star, jumps happily under a shady mango tree. Beside him, 6-year-old twin superhero Veera, wearing a pink suit, yellow cape, pink eye mask, and blue star, claps as Veer plucks a ripe yellow mango. Camera slowly zooms in on their smiling faces.
scenes.sound: gentle breeze rustling leaves and birds chirping
scenes.narration: Veer and Veera found a sweet, juicy mango in the sunny garden today.

scenes.visual: Veer, in his blue superhero suit and red cape, holds the bright mango close, feeling excited. Veera, in her pink superhero suit and yellow cape with yellow bows in her ponytails, looks at the mango with wide, curious eyes. Veer hesitates, looking at his sister's eager face, then offers a warm, gentle smile. Camera slowly pans around them.
scenes.sound: soft rustling grass and gentle wind chimes
scenes.narration: Veer wanted to eat it all, but he saw Veera's hopeful smile.

scenes.visual: Veer, wearing his blue superhero suit and red cape, carefully splits the soft mango into two equal halves. He proudly hands one big half to Veera, who wears her pink superhero suit and yellow cape. Veera giggles with joy, her eyes twinkling behind her pink mask. Camera pulls back slightly to show both happy twins.
scenes.sound: soft giggles and birds singing nearby
scenes.narration: With a big smile, Veer shared half the tasty treat with Veera!

scenes.visual: As they eat, a friendly little squirrel hops onto a wooden bench beside them, twitching its bushy tail. Veer, in his blue superhero suit, red cape, and blue mask, and Veera, in her pink superhero suit, yellow cape, and pink mask, both tilt their heads softly. They look at the hungry squirrel and smile together. Camera tilts down slightly.
scenes.sound: gentle squirrel chattering and soft leaf rustle
scenes.narration: Suddenly, a tiny squirrel hopped over, wishing for a little snack too.

scenes.visual: Veer, in his blue suit and red cape, and Veera, in her pink suit and yellow cape, gently place small fruit pieces on the bench. The cute squirrel nibbles happily while Veer and Veera cheer, their capes fluttering softly in the warm afternoon breeze. Camera slowly pans up into the sunny sky above them.
scenes.sound: soft joyful giggles, gentle wind, and happy bird chirps
scenes.narration: Sharing their mango made everyone’s day so much sweeter and happier!
